column1: # Touch hints of Rhythm Heaven Groove: which buttons each scene uses, for the iPhone gamepad's Rhythm layout (pad_layout rhythm; hle_touchhint.c has the format).
# The right half of the controls area always presses A; the left half follows these rows.
# From MIT-licensed Touchable (github.com/MZhao-ouo/Touchable, by mzhao: internal/games/rhythm-heaven/runtime/rh_touch.c). Its notes:
#   a minigame shows its title card from graph/prologue/<name>/ and plays from graph/scene/<name>/; menus read graph/menu/ and results graph/result/.
#   A remix reads several scene folders after its title card, so the keys of every scene read since the last title card are combined.
#   The level rows list the buttons each minigame uses besides A, from the button icons in the controller prompts of mesg/CN/CNzh/stage_<name>_00.msbt
#   (labels without the "H" suffix, which describe a single sideways Joy-Con). Y (hold for a demo), - (skip practice) and + (pause) are not listed: the gamepad has keys for them.
#   BeatSpell (graph/beatspell/) steps with B or down, casts with A or right, backflips with left or Y; its map and lists use up / down, X and Y: the left half presses B, with the
#   four directions, X and Y shown too. Drum Lessons (graph/scene/drummer/) use almost every button: the whole controller.
# More buttons than two areas hold, or no prompts to read (many): the left half is four directions. remix adds no keys itself; its scenes do
